measurement: sage kernel mode x Sol-Attn reachability, end to end
why: `docs/evidence.md` withdrew every fp8-vs-fp16 accuracy ratio on 2026-08-16, leaving the shipped `fp16 (most accurate)` default resting only on a perceptual verdict taken 2026-08-13 at 124 frames with Sol ABSENT -- one day before Sol-Attn landed. This run measures the cost side in the configuration actually shipped.
method: One variable per arm, same graph, same seed, same sequence. Sampler seconds are read from the progress line, so model load and VAE decode are excluded. One run per arm.

arms.note: the shipped configuration before this run
auto resolves to fp8_cuda++ on sm89
ref2va checkpoint direct, no ref LoRA; isolates the LoRA's 320 attached patches
the owner's live UI graph: sage node bypassed, Sol min_tokens 11776, morton on

sol_worth_at_fp16.means: what an unreachable Sol node costs, at the shipped sage mode

fp16_cost_with_sol.means: what fp16 costs in the SHIPPED config, where Sol takes 11 of 16 steps

fp16_cost_dense.means: what fp16 costs when sage runs all 16 steps

ref_lora_cost.means: fl2va + ref LoRA against the ref2va checkpoint direct

per_step.window: start_percent 0.2 / end_percent 0.9 with scheduler `simple` at 16 steps gives Sol 11 sparse and 5 dense
per_step.reading: the sparse-step cost is the same in both sage modes -- Sol's kernel does not depend on the sage mode -- so the entire fp16 difference is carried by the 5 dense steps

caveats: One run per arm. This bench's run-to-run spread was measured at 0.1-0.12% on a previous occasion, but that was a different harness.
Ratios were measured at packed sequence 75,118. Sol's advantage grows with sequence length, so the Sol ratios understate at 362 frames.

The board power limit was 330 W against a stock 450 W for this whole run. Every arm shares it, so the RATIOS hold; the absolute seconds are not comparable to any number recorded before 2026-08-17 15:39.
Sampler seconds only. Total wall clock adds model load, text encoding and VAE decode, which no arm varied.
This measures COST. It says nothing about output quality; the paired clips rendered at the same seed are the evidence for that question.
